challenge.title: Hosting or Visiting: A Full Exchange
challenge.instructions: Write a short conversation where you either welcome a guest into your home from the door to the table, or visit someone else's home and take your leave at the end. Use at least one greeting-at-the-door phrase, one phrase about food or drink, and one closing/thanking phrase.
required_elements: a welcome phrase at the door (e.g. tikram 3eenak / itfaddal fuut)
an offer of food or drink (e.g. shu bit7ibbu tishrabu)
a closing thanks or goodbye (e.g. yislamu iideekun / mar3 is-salaame)
